name: canon-keeper
description: Automatically extract and persist learnings from Copilot conversations to your project's knowledge base

chatParticipants.name: keeper
chatParticipants.description: Extract and save learnings from our conversation

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save the current conversation's learnings to your knowledge base

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review what would be extracted from this conversation

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current memory extraction settings and statistics

disambiguation.description: The user wants to save, persist, or remember something from the conversation for future sessions.
examples: Save this decision to my instructions

canonKeeper.copilotInstructionsPath.description: Path to your Copilot instructions file (relative to workspace root)

canonKeeper.agentCanonPath.description: Path to agent-specific canon folder (relative to workspace root)

canonKeeper.classificationModel.description: Model to use for classifying learnings (auto = use chat's current model)

canonKeeper.minimumConfidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0-1) required to auto-save a learning

canonKeeper.requireConfirmation.description: Ask for confirmation before writing to files

canonKeeper.autoInitialize.description: Automatically check and offer to initialize copilot-instructions.md with best practices on first activation
